sources.title: Accounts payable invoice matching overview
sources.scope: The Three-way matching, Two-way price totals matching, and Related functionality sections; full primary page retrieved and read.
supported_claims: Three-way matching compares invoice and PO prices and invoice quantities with selected product receipts.
The documented combined percentage-and-amount price-total configuration treats either exceeded tolerance as a discrepancy.
Matching discrepancies can remain available for review and correction.
sources.limitations: Product documentation, not a regulation or evidence of native execution. This sample's symmetric unit-price test, independent per-line cap, exact keys, thresholds and collision policy are invented. It does not reproduce cumulative last-invoice price-total matching, taxes, discounts, charges, currency conversion, posting or payment.

sources.title: Vendor invoices overview
sources.scope: Preventing invoice submission to workflow and Matching vendor invoices to product receipts; full primary page retrieved and read.
supported_claims: Configured duplicate-number controls can prevent submission when a posted invoice already has that number.
Invoice matching can select partial quantities of product receipt lines.
An invoice can use receipts available through the current date rather than all ordered quantities.
sources.limitations: The synthetic canonical business key, all-incoming-duplicates hold, explicit cutoff, historical capacity checks and selection policy are sample controls, not universal Finance behavior. No workflow approval, source connection, invoice capture, posting or payment is performed.
